item.title: Vijay Arora Birthday: Actor Immortalised by 110 Films and Ramayana’s Indrajit
item.description: Vijay Arora (27 December 1944 – 2 February 2007) was an Indian actor who appeared in Hindi films and television serials. He is best known for his roles as Meghnad/Indrajit in the film Yaadon Ki Baaraat and the TV serial Ramayan. Career Vijay Arora graduated from the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) in 1971, receiving a gold medal.
